newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Esprit proposes stock placement.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Esprit proposes stock placement.

text.p: Malaysian engineering concern Esprit Group Bhd said it is proposing a private placement of nearly two million new shares representing about 10 percent of its paid-up share capital.
In a statement released late on Wednesday, the company said the new 1,999,000 share placement would increase its capital from 19,999,000 shares to 21,998,000 shares.

A sum of 7.5 million ringgit of the proceeds would be injected as fresh equity funds into Esprit unit Esprit Development (Seremban) Sdn Bhd to activate its property development activities, the statement said.

The balance would be used to pay back bank debt, provide working capital and defray issue expenses. Esprit said it would provide a detailed breakdown of the proceeds utilisation when the issue price for the placement is determined.
